qualityChecklist: Answers the specific reader or buyer task immediately
Uses accurate product facts and specific first-party experience
Cites current primary documentation for technical instructions
Separates company-reported outcomes from independently verified evidence
Avoids unverified statistics and universal AI-platform claims
Adds useful original detail rather than synonym paragraphs
Has an accountable author, reviewer and review date
Keeps grid, comparison and conversion tasks usable on mobile
Links to the relevant commercial destination with a useful anchor
Matches structured data to visible content and eligibility rules
